video-editing-ai-chatgpt 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Launches AI-powered video editing via chat for raw footage in MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (max 500MB).
- Supports text-based editing prompts for trims, transitions, captions, aspect ratio, BGM, and more.
- Automatic setup: guides user through cloud connection and token generation for 100 free credits.
- Handles uploads, edits, exports (1080p MP4), credit checks, and session state via a simple chat workflow.
- Includes error handling, job queueing, and live progress updates.
- Designed for easy use by content creators and marketers — no manual editing required.
